NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author squashed the earlier fixup commits (4 down to 2) and replied that the screenshots can't show this change. No code or screenshots were updated, and the commit titles are the same as before.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | Screenshots still don't meet the precise before/after guidelines. The tab-vs-space difference does show up to users, since "Copy code" now returns tabs, so it can be shown. |
| ❌  | Commit titles are still "fix for issue 17419" and "added test case for issue 17418", not Zulip's `area: Summary.` format. The test is also still in a separate commit from the fix, and the title cites the wrong issue number. |
| ℹ️  | The author asked whether a screen recording or a different kind of demonstration would be acceptable, so a triager can answer that. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and send the reply below.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing the commits, @adityas27! The commit titles still need to follow the [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) format (e.g. "markdown: Preserve tabs in fenced code blocks."), and the test should go in the same commit as the fix. For the screenshots, the difference is visible to users, e.g. by showing the whitespace in a text editor after copying, so please follow the [precise before/after screenshots guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
